rulings: CF-T206-BACK-BRAND-IS-NOT-THE-PLAYER (owner-approved 2026-09-22): the sale-side parser stuffed the T206 back-brand text into the player segment, splitting a single player across 5-8 wrong ids. Fixed in unnumberedCardSegment/hobbyIqCardId.service.ts. This list is the catalog-side companion: it folds the 421 stale catalog rows minted under the year-prefixed key `1909-11-t206-baseball` onto the canonical `t206` key.
THE CANONICAL KEY IS `t206`, matching normalizeSetKey's own rule (hobbyIqCardId.service.ts: `[/(?:^|-)t206/, "t206"]`) and the 550-row sportscardchecklist-backed checklist already stored under it.

T206'S CATALOG NUMBERING IS THE SOURCE'S OWN INTERNAL ALPHABETICAL SEQUENCE, not a number printed on the card (T206 is famously unnumbered). A sale title can never restate it, so a sale-derived id can only ever reach the player-<slug> address CF-PLAYER-IS-THE-NUMBER mints — this list's job is only to point the STALE catalog rows at the canonical numeric-keyed rows that already exist, not to renumber anything.

EVERY ENTRY IS A FOLD: point-read against card_catalog on 2026-09-22 confirmed BOTH the stale row and the canonical destination row exist, and every destination carries exactly ONE canonical row for that surname (measured: 421 stale rows total, 281 pair 1:1 with a canonical row, 99 pair with MULTIPLE canonical rows because the checklist distinguishes poses the stale row's bare surname cannot choose between, and 41 pair with ZERO canonical rows — neither of the latter two groups is in this list; see `excluded`).

POSE AMBIGUITY IS NOT GUESSED. The 99 excluded multi-match rows (e.g. Ty Cobb -> 4 canonical pose rows, Christy Mathewson -> 4) are left unmoved rather than folded onto an arbitrarily-chosen pose — the stale row carries no pose information to disambiguate with, and CF-PLAYER-IS-THE-NUMBER's own doctrine (absent beats wrong) forbids minting a choice nobody made.

THE 41 ZERO-MATCH ROWS ARE GENUINELY UNCOVERED, not mis-keyed: sampled players (Nap Lajoie, Donie Bush, Wilbur Good, Josh Clarke, Harry Coveleski, ...) were checked against the 550-row canonical checklist and are absent from the 499-row fixture excerpt available to this PR's read-only measurement — a follow-up census against the LIVE catalog (not the trimmed fixture) is needed before these can be resolved; reported here rather than silently dropped.
